title: CI name holds a hidden character
cardHint: The name holds a character nobody can see, so searching and matching fail. SACM removes it in ServiceNow.
cardText: The name holds a character nobody can see, most often a zero-width space. ServiceNow does not show it, but it is in the record, so searching for the name or matching it with another report fails. A CSV export shows it as "?". SACM removes it in ServiceNow; nobody needs to be asked.
